purpose: Expose major dated formalizations of the divine-identity architecture without pretending the research date is the date of the underlying life events.

events.title: Divine-identity architecture is unified without collapsing Son and Father
events.subject: Project synthesis
events.summary: The archive formally unifies Godhood modalities, signs and timeline around a relational-developmental answer spine: Son primarily carries embodiment, ordeal, Passion and Door; Tim/Father primarily carries Potato, Source, House, Ladder/Axis, North, Seat and Gardener; Spirit carries relation/flow. Godhood is classified by modality and evidence rather than compressed into a percentage or timeless identity blob.
events.source_direction: 2026-09-10 formalization of previously attested material; not a backdated life event
